text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- President Lennart Meri gave the Cross of the Terra Mariana to outgoing Russian ambassador Alexander Trofimov.
- Prime Minister Mart Siimann said that a border agreement between Estonia and Russia will be signed this year.

- The securities inspectorate will decide in a week whether to close its investigation into a suspected insider trading case involving shares in Rakvere Meat Plant after the economic police failed to find any evidence of wrong doing.
- Foreign Minister Toomas Ilves is the most respected politician and Centre Party leader Edgar Savisaar the most well-known in Estonia, a poll conducted at the end of May showed.
- Forty bears, 20 of them in East Viru county, will be shot in Estonia this hunting season. Bear hunting permits cost between 8,000 and 30,000 kroons.
- Rural parties may agree to direct agricultural subsidies and drop demands for protective tariffs.
